items.caption:
How to spot a fake job offer by text (4 red flags)
A real employer never asks you to pay to get a job.

1. No real interview: you're "hired" after a few texts
2. You must pay first, for training, equipment or a starter kit
3. Chat app only: no video call, no company email
4. They send you a check to buy equipment or send money back

Spot one? Don't pay and don't tap links. Look the company up yourself, find its real careers page, and call the number listed there. US: report it at ReportFraud.ftc.gov. UK: forward scam texts to 7726 (free on most networks). Not legal advice.
